title: Scott Walker drops an anthem of resilience and healing with "This Is What Love Can Feel Like"
htmlContent: From the serenity of Wichita Falls, Texas, resides a sound that embodies strength and openness. Emerging singer-songwriter and Active Duty United States Air Force member Scott Walker offers his most personal and poignant project to date with new single, "This Is What Love Can Feel Like." Penned, recorded, and produced by Walker in his home studio, the song expresses an emphatic nod to Walker's artistic autonomy and introspective dimension. Influenced by the raw honesty of Dashboard Confessional and the melodic tendencies of bands like Goo Goo Dolls and Third Eye Blind, Scott can establish a sound that feels both thoughtful and refreshingly his own. https://open.spotify.com/track/75s8clcMSjfBiqaUH1xFiv "This Is What Love Can Feel Like" is a story of rebirth. The words softly open the door to healing old wounds and finding love anew. Walker's rasp-soaked vocals slip, dream-like, through polished song constructions that somehow manage to alternate between feeling intimate and grand. His choice not to adhere to conventional song structures ensures the track has a meandering emotional pulse, reflecting the way love itself can take us on unpredictable journeys. With Walker still doing his duty for the country whilst chasing his dreams, "This Is What Love Can Feel Like" marks a defining chapter in his evolving artistry. It's a song that makes you feel what love sounds like. With this track, Scott Walker welcomes you into his universe, one of raw power, rugged endurance, and the sort of love that not only moves mountains but cures them.
